DNSOverTLS=yes requires encryption and does not fall back to plaintext on failure as opportunistic can. The first empty DNS= line clears previously accumulated global server entries.

Internal VPN domains or per-link DNSOverTLS settings may take priority over this global configuration. You must adjust that link's NetworkManager or systemd-networkd settings separately; the global file alone does not mean all DNS has changed.
resolvectl status에서 전역 및 사용하는 링크의 DNS·라우: In resolvectl status, check DNS, routing and DoT settings for Global and the links you use, then make sure an actual lookup without the cache succeeds.
